rent_scenario_notes: Structurally this is a Revenue-Share Cooperation Agreement, not a conventional lease: BBB pays no fixed rent, only 15% of Net Sales Value (flat, no escalation/threshold across all 5 years) plus a fixed Rp15,000,000/month IPL fee covering utilities, security and cleaning. Separately — and in the opposite direction from a normal tenant deposit — the PARTNER (property owner) must pay BBB an upfront Investment Cost of Rp211,670,000 excl. VAT (not subject to PPh withholding) to buy the operating equipment and fixtures listed in Appendix I; this is a capex/asset payment, not rent, and should not be entered as a Security Deposit or Total Contract Value. Termination rights are asymmetric: the PARTNER can exit unilaterally after 3 consecutive months of missed revenue targets; BBB can exit with 3 months' notice by assigning to a similar operator. Disputes go to BANI arbitration in Jakarta, conducted in Indonesian, with a binding, non-appealable award — no court recourse. If treated as a rent-tracker row alongside the firm's conventional leases, most of the standard fixed-rent fields (Base Rent, Total Contract Value, Installments, Security Deposit) will read 'NA' by design.
